desc: 雪燕树胶干货套图模版：白底主图、玄底晶透氛围、泡发拉丝微距、四物搭配与信任收口
name: 晶莹易泡发雪燕慢炖羹款

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，干净合规的干货主体
深色氛围里一秒放大泡发后晶莹剔透的视觉记忆点
用浑浊呆滞与晶透干净的同框对比放大选材顾虑
shots.textZone: one short label per panel 「{callout_1}」 and 「{callout_2}」

shots.intent: 代入慢下来炖一盅羹的生活场景，完成自我投射
微距拉丝证明泡发后莹润通透的胶质感
干态微距呈现原料本来的形态与洁净度
平铺展示可同炖的四种干货搭配，给组合选购理由
shots.textZone: one short label under each bowl 「{callout_3}」 「{callout_4}」

shots.intent: 用分步图解讲清泡发炖煮流程，消除不会做的顾虑
以干净的罐身与留白参数行建立可核查的信任感
以一碗成品热羹与行动按钮完成收口促单

style.backgroundSystem: deep charcoal-black #16130F for atmosphere heroes, warm paper beige #F5F1E8 for infographic and macro panels, clean white #FFFFFF for packshot and trust
style.iconSystem: minimal thin-line callout marks in the amber accent only
style.lightingSystem: warm studio lighting with a soft front-left key, gentle speculars through the translucent gum, soft contact shadows, no harsh highlights
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium oriental tonic dry-goods visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of deep charcoal-black backdrop #16130F, warm paper beige #F5F1E8, amber gold accent #C89B5A and charcoal text #33302B; warm studio lighting with a soft front-left key, gentle speculars through the translucent gum and soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif; minimal thin-line callout marks in the amber accent only; clean high-end food photography mixed with quiet infographic panels; stable centered product placement and consistent scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
style.presentationRules: stable centered product placement, consistent scale across the set, product never covered by props
style.surfaceSystem: dark rustic wood #2A2119, warm linen cloth and light matte stone #F2EDE4
